mapper.select: /* CastChknMapper.retrieveCknctCntList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, COUNT(A.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' -- A, B 유인 체크인카운터 / H 셀프백드랍 AND A.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY ISLAND

/* CastChknMapper.retrieveUserChknIslandList */ SELECT A.CHKN_ISL_CD AS ISLAND, NVL(A.BOOTH_CNT, 0) AS BOOTH_CNT, NVL(A.KOS_CNT, 0) AS KIOSK_CNT, NVL(A.SBD_CNT, 0) AS BAG_DROP_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ORDER BY A.CHKN_ISL_CD

/* CastChknMapper.retrieveUserChknBoothList */ SELECT A.CHKN_ISL_CD AS ISLAND, A.BOOTH_NO, A.ALN_CD, A.CSTM_ALTMNT_YN AS CSTM_ALTMNT_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_BOOTH A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ORDER BY A.CHKN_ISL_CD, A.BOOTH_NO
